name: claudish_proxy_events
description: Structured events the claudish-proxy emits (jsonPayload.event), counted by event and severity. Errors and capacity signals: request_error, loop_fell_through, loop_retry_failed, loop_empty_result, loop_failed_midstream, lane_failed, capacity_ladder_exhausted, budget_threshold, capacity_no_budget, rate_limited.

pct.description: budget percentage on a budget_threshold event (50, 80, 100); empty on other events

name: data_generator_ad_insert_failures
description: data-generator's one failure pattern: the plain-text '[ad-insert] N/M rows failed' line.

name: cloud_run_no_instance
description: Cloud Run aborted a request because no instance was available (sGTM logged sixteen in the week to 2026-09-04, clustered at the scheduler's 10:00 burst), counted per service.
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND severity>=ERROR AND textPayload:"no available instance"

name: event_stream_errors
description: event-stream emits no error logs today (its catch blocks are silent and failures surface as HTTP 400s); the counter exists so an error, if one is ever logged, counts.
